#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long best_x = -1, best_y, A, B, N;

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("a.in", "r", stdin);
#endif
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld", &A, &B, &N);
    for (long long y = 1; y <= N; ++y) {
        long long x = y * A / B;
        if (best_x == -1) {
            best_x = x;
            best_y = y;
        }
        if (abs(A * y - B * x) * best_y < abs(A * best_y - B * best_x) * y) {
            best_x = x;
            best_y = y;
        }
        ++x;
        if (abs(A * y - B * x) * best_y < abs(A * best_y - B * best_x) * y) {
            best_x = x;
            best_y = y;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", best_x, best_y);
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
